slots.label: Word equations and conservation of mass

items.q: Which is a sign that a chemical reaction has happened?
items.qAf: Watter is ’n teken dat ’n chemiese reaksie plaasgevind het?
options: A gas is produced and the colour changes
optionsAf: ŉ Gas word gemaak en die kleur verander
items.explain: A new substance forms in a chemical change, often with a colour change, gas, heat or a precipitate.
items.explainAf: In ’n chemiese verandering vorm ’n nuwe stof, dikwels met ’n kleurverandering, gas, hitte of ’n neerslag.

items.q: Burning a piece of wood is a chemical change. Which evidence supports this?
items.qAf: Om ’n stuk hout te verbrand is ’n chemiese verandering. Watter bewys ondersteun dit?
options: Ash and gases are formed, and it cannot easily be reversed
optionsAf: As en gasse word gevorm, en dit kan nie maklik omgekeer word nie
items.explain: Burning forms new substances (ash, carbon dioxide, water vapour) that cannot easily turn back into wood.
items.explainAf: Verbranding vorm nuwe stowwe (as, koolstofdioksied, waterdamp) wat nie maklik weer hout kan word nie.

items.q: What is the law of conservation of mass?
items.qAf: Wat is die wet van behoud van massa?
options: Mass is created in a reaction
Mass is lost in every reaction
Mass is the same before and after a reaction in a closed system
optionsAf: Massa gaan in elke reaksie verlore
Massa is dieselfde voor en na ’n reaksie in ’n geslote stelsel
items.explain: In a closed system the total mass of the reactants equals the total mass of the products.
items.explainAf: In ’n geslote stelsel is die totale massa van die reaktante gelyk aan die totale massa van die produkte.

items.q: In a word equation, what are the substances on the left called?
items.qAf: Hoe word die stowwe aan die linkerkant van ’n woordvergelyking genoem?
items.explain: Reactants are the starting substances; products are formed on the right of the arrow.
items.explainAf: Reaktante is die beginstowwe; produkte word aan die regterkant van die pyltjie gevorm.

items.q: Iron reacts with oxygen to form iron oxide. Which word equation is correct?
items.qAf: Yster reageer met suurstof om ystersoksied te vorm. Watter woordvergelyking is korrek?
items.explain: The reactants iron and oxygen are on the left, with the product iron oxide on the right.
items.explainAf: Die reaktante yster en suurstof is aan die linkerkant, met die produk ystersoksied aan die regterkant.

items.q: Hydrogen burns with oxygen to form water. If 4 g of hydrogen and 32 g of oxygen react completely, what is the mass of water formed?
items.qAf: Waterstof brand met suurstof om water te vorm. As 4 g waterstof en 32 g suurstof heeltemal reageer, wat is die massa water wat gevorm word?
items.explain: Mass is conserved: 4 g + 32 g = 36 g of water.
items.explainAf: Massa word behou: 4 g + 32 g = 36 g water.

items.q: The substances that you start with in a chemical reaction.
items.qAf: Die stowwe waarmee jy in ’n chemiese reaksie begin.

items.q: The new substances formed in a chemical reaction.
items.qAf: Die nuwe stowwe wat in ’n chemiese reaksie gevorm word.

items.q: A solid that forms when two solutions react.
items.qAf: ’n Vastestof wat vorm wanneer twee oplossings reageer.

items.q: A reaction that gives off heat to the surroundings.
items.qAf: ’n Reaksie wat hitte aan die omgewing afgee.

items.text: In a chemical reaction atoms are not created or destroyed, so the total [[]] of the reactants equals that of the products. This is the law of conservation of [[]].
items.textAf: In ’n chemiese reaksie word atome nie geskep of vernietig nie, dus is die totale [[]] van die reaktante gelyk aan dié van die produkte. Dit is die wet van behoud van [[]].

items.text: Rusting is a reaction between iron, [[]] and water. The product is iron [[]].
items.textAf: Roes is ’n reaksie tussen yster, [[]] en water. Die produk is yster[[]].

items.q: Melting ice is a chemical change.
items.qAf: Ys wat smelt, is ’n chemiese verandering.
items.explain: False. Melting is a physical change: no new substance forms and it can be reversed.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Smelting is ’n fisiese verandering: geen nuwe stof vorm nie en dit kan omgekeer word.

items.q: A change in colour or the release of a gas can show that a chemical reaction has taken place.
items.qAf: ’n Kleurverandering of die vrystelling van ’n gas kan wys dat ’n chemiese reaksie plaasgevind het.
items.explain: True. Other signs are heat or light given off, or a precipitate forming.
items.explainAf: Waar. Ander tekens is hitte of lig wat afgegee word, of ’n presipitaat wat vorm.

items.q: In the equation 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O there are four hydrogen atoms on each side.
items.qAf: In die vergelyking 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O is daar vier waterstofatome aan elke kant.
items.explain: True. 2H₂ has 4 H atoms and 2H₂O has 4 H atoms, so the equation is balanced.
items.explainAf: Waar. 2H₂ het 4 H-atome en 2H₂O het 4 H-atome, dus is die vergelyking gebalanseer.

items.q: 12 g of magnesium burns in oxygen to form 20 g of magnesium oxide. What mass of oxygen reacted?
items.qAf: 12 g magnesium brand in suurstof om 20 g magnesiumoksied te vorm. Watter massa suurstof het gereageer?
items.explain: Conservation of mass: mass of oxygen = 20 g − 12 g = 8 g.
items.explainAf: Behoud van massa: massa suurstof = 20 g − 12 g = 8 g.
